notes: Convert Memorize Script from Vite/TypeScript to plain PHP + vanilla JS for zero-npm local runs.
Keep product behavior: localStorage persistence, copy/paste ChatGPT prompts, no LLM API, no backend accounts.
Error-fix budget for AGENTS_LOOP-Convert-PHP.md is 5 rounds.
TS MVP (M0–M10) remains historical; PHP track IDs are P0–P10.

milestones.name: Freeze PHP conversion decisions
milestones.goal: Lock PHP stack, folder layout, and parity checklist so conversion does not thrash.
deliverables: docs/PHP_CONVERSION.md with layout + run command + feature parity list
acceptance: stack = PHP built-in server + vanilla JS (no Vite/npm required to run)
public/ is the web root; assets under public/assets/
Parity list covers library, all 7 stages, scoreboard, share, starters, export/import

milestones.name: PHP shell + CSS + run path
milestones.goal: App opens via php -S with branded shell and empty mount point.
acceptance: php -S can serve public/index.php (smoke via php -l + file checks)
index.php includes CSS and a #app root
No npm required to view the shell

deliverables: tests/php or tests/js repository tests runnable without Vite (node --test or php)
acceptance: No TypeScript build step for these modules
